Reveal any cell: the first tap and the surrounding square are safe. Numbers show the total weight of neighboring mines: ordinary mines count as 1, double mines as 2. Empty cells reveal their neighbors.

Tap to reveal a cell; hold to flag it. The bottom toggle changes the primary action. Tap a number with enough flagged mine weight to reveal its other neighbors. Drag vertically to scroll and cancel the tap.

A mine costs one heart, a double mine two. Reveal every safe cell, choose a find, and visit the shop after each layer. Select a tool below, then choose its target. An earth hint is always safe.

A run has two Turf fields, two Clay fields, two Rock fields and a keeper. Defeat also earns ore; spend it in the workshop. Victory unlocks the next depth, with new conditions and an ore bonus. Pure Minesweeper has no finds or special mines; Deeper continues endlessly.

Every move is saved. Fields and countdowns pause while you are away. Travel doubles ore, step energy grants a starting Probe, and ore can fund a daily bet.
